definitions.explanation: An adult female human. A formal and neutral term for referring to women.

examples.japanese: {女性|じょせい}⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}りました→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: I rode in the women-only car.
examples.notes: Train cars for women during rush hour

notes:
{女性|じょせい} is a formal, neutral term for women.

COMPARISON OF TERMS:
- {女性|じょせい}: woman (formal, neutral)
- ⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧: woman/female (can be rude in some contexts)
- ⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: woman (polite, everyday)
- ⟦{女|おんな}の{子|こ}→女の子：02865_onnanoko⟧: girl
- {女|め}: female (literary, compounds)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女性|じょせい}⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧: female employee
- {女性|じょせい}⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧: women-only
- {女性|じょせい}⟦{向|む}け→向け：11011_muke⟧: for women
- ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧{女性|じょせい}: young woman

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧: man, male
